channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about CJ McCollum | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about CJ McCollum from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Onsi Saleh on CJ McCollum, Trae Young, Corey Kispert
item.description:
Atlanta Hawks GM Onsi Saleh on trading Trae Young for CJ McCollum and Corey Kispert:

“On behalf of the Hawks franchise, I’d like to thank Trae for how he embraced the city of Atlanta and represented the Hawks during his time here, on the court and in the community. Over more than seven seasons, including four All-Star appearances, he cemented himself as a fan favorite and one of the great players in our franchise’s history. We wish Trae and his family all the best.”

Onsi Saleh on CJ McCollum, Trae Young, Corey Kispert, Jan 9, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on CJ McCollum
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Jayson Tatum on the Boston crowd:

“I was at the free throw line and CJ McCollum asked me, ‘Is it always this turnt up in here?’ I was like, ‘Yeah.’”

Jayson Tatum on CJ McCollum, Jan 13, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Norman Powell on DeMar DeRozan, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum
item.description:
Powell said Wednesday night.

“Learning from when I was in Toronto with Kyle and DeMar (DeRozan), learning from Dame (Lillard) and CJ (McCollum), learning from PG and Kawhi. Being around those top guys and just getting game and knowledge from them in the summer. Going up against them, battling, and just wanting that.”

Norman Powell on DeMar DeRozan, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Nov 8, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
“Melo [Anthony] was actually still on theroster. I really took the job thinking that I was going to be coaching him. You know with Dame [Lillard] and CJ [McCollum], Nurk [Nurkic]. So it was perfect for me, I'm thinking okay boom, a few moves here and there, I'm coming to like try to elevate things and then very quickly it changed.”

Chauncey Billups on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Jusuf Nurkic, Jul 23, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Luguentz Dort on CJ McCollum, Brandon Ingram
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Lu Dort on guarding Brandon Ingram & CJ McCollum:

“This is what I’ve dreamed for. I’ve been doing this my whole career now. Just having different matchups.”

Luguentz Dort on CJ McCollum, Brandon Ingram, Apr 22, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Zion Williamson on CJ McCollum
item.description:
Andrew Lopez:Zion on CJ issue at All-Star break:

“Honestly, I was focused on rehabbing around that time. I texted CJ shortly after to apologize about that. Like I said, I was mentally not in a good space. Mr. McCollum, he was cool about it.”

Zion Williamson on CJ McCollum, May 1, 2022. Source: Twitter @_Andrew_Lopez.

item.title: Antonio Daniels on Stephen A. Smith, Willie Green, CJ McCollum
item.description:
Antonio Daniels:

“What you have here in New Orleans is, a lot was going on early on in the season, new pieces trying to fit in along with head coach Willie Green. And that's a lot to take on early; 1-12, 3-16 is what this team started. And now, at that time, the talk was, 'Let's tank. There's no Zion.' Fans all said they should just tank the season. Even when you acquired CJ McCollum. I remember Stephen A. Smith saying, 'Oh, I don't know what they're doing. Why would CJ McCollum want to go there? New Orleans ain't going anywhere anyway.’”

Antonio Daniels on Stephen A. Smith, Willie Green, CJ McCollum, Apr 28, 2022. Source: basketballnews.com.

item.title: Nicolas Batum on CJ McCollum
item.description:
Law Murray:Batum on former Portland teammate CJ McCollum in New Orleans:

“It's good for him. I think his time with the Blazers was done. I think he had to move on. Sad to say that, because I love the organization. But it was time for him and the organization to move on...”

Nicolas Batum on CJ McCollum, Apr 14, 2022. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Larry Nance Jr on CJ McCollum
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Larry Nance Jr. on CJ McCollum (25 pts, 6 ast):

“CJ has been a top-five skilled player in the NBA.His skill level is through the roof. It just so happened that Dame was alpha (in Portland), and rightfully so. Seeing CJ step into his own here as lead guard, I'm not surprised.”

Larry Nance Jr on CJ McCollum, Mar 25, 2022. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Devonte Graham on CJ McCollum, Brandon Ingram
item.description:
Devonte' Graham on #Pelicans:

“(Ingram) takes and makes difficult shots for us. When we don’t have anything going, he takes a lot of pressure off us by knocking those shots down. When you’ve got an All-Star like that, him and CJ (McCollum) not in the game, it’s a huge adjustment”

Devonte Graham on CJ McCollum, Brandon Ingram, Mar 11, 2022. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Chauncey Billups, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum
item.description:
Mark Medina:Blazers interim GM Joe Cronin on Damian Lillard & C.J. McCollum:

“They're happy with Chauncey and his staff. We know there's something we need to do with the roster, and we will.”

Joe Cronin on Chauncey Billups, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Dec 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum
item.description:
“Damian Lillard does the same s--t on Twitter, CJ McCollum does the same s--t on Twitter. We all do the same s--t on Twitter. But for me, it’s a problem. I chalk it up to me being so good at what I do and playing with a team that was so great.”

Kevin Durant on Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Aug 19, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Monty Williams on Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum
item.description:
Monty Williams on the Blazers:

“They're a well-balanced team with arguably the MVP right now. I don't know if anyone has carried their team the way Damian has without McCollum. Nobody's been able to stop him. He poses a lot of problems. He's just an amazing basketball player.”

Monty Williams on Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Feb 22, 2021. Source: Twitter @PDXjay.

item.title: Michael Malone on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Robert Covington, Rodney Hood, Jusuf Nurkic, Zach Collins
item.description:
Michael Malone on the Blazers, Denver's opponent tomorrow:

“I think Portland's really good. Last year they were decimated by injuries. I think Terry does a really good job as their coach. One of the best backcourts in the NBA with CJ McCollum and Damian Lillard, Carmelo Anthony, Jusuf Nurkic. They've got Rodney Hood back. Zach Collins back. They get Robert Covington. They're a good basketball team. I think they're going to have a much better season in the regular season than they had last year because they're going to be healthy.”

Michael Malone on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Robert Covington, Rodney Hood, Jusuf Nurkic, Zach Collins, Dec 15, 2020. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Channing Frye on CJ McCollum, Marcus Smart, Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Channing Frye:

“If you want CJ McCollum and somebody, you’d have to give me Jaylen Brown and Marcus Smart… That’s what I see CJ’s value as.”

Channing Frye on CJ McCollum, Marcus Smart, Jaylen Brown, Nov 8, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Myles Turner on CJ McCollum
item.description:
Pacers center Myles Turner on C.J. McCollum‘s podcast:

“My dad actually got it. He made a full recovery. But just seeing him kind of go through it was huge, because you see all the memes, and it’s funny and stuff on Twitter until something actually happens to you. And seeing my dad get it, he was super weak. He could barely talk.”

Myles Turner on CJ McCollum, Apr 10, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum
item.description:
Wizards coach Scott Brooks on @CJ McCollum:

“CJ is playing out of his mind right now, but he’s very capable of playing like that all the time. He’s a tricky player, right there (close) to being an all-star. With @Damian Lillard, that’s as good a backcourt as there is in the league.”

Scott Brooks on Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Mar 4, 2020. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on CJ McCollum
item.description:
As Anthony told The Athletic:

“I got the call saying, ‘Portland is interested, what are you thinking?’ I just said, ‘Look, I’ve been in this situation before. Just tell me when it’s something we can really make happen. Tell me when it’s real.’ “It really wasn’t any conversations. I was continuing to go on with life and hanging with my fam and doing my other business ventures. Then Dame called me. CJ (McCollum) called me. Zach called me. Everybody, a lot of people texted me and called me. But it had to be something that I felt comfortable with and that they felt comfortable with. We got on the phone, got comfortable and went from there.”

Carmelo Anthony on CJ McCollum, Nov 26, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Damian Lillard on CJ McCollum, Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Lillard told Yahoo Sports.

“We played without our starting center [Jusuf Nurkic, who suffered a season-ending leg injury]. We played without CJ [McCollum] toward the end of the season. So, looking at that, we were still able to get here. We were one step away [from the Finals]. And not only here, we had double-digit leads in three of the four games. I think getting here is reassuring that we can get the job done.”

Damian Lillard on CJ McCollum, Jusuf Nurkic, May 21, 2019. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Draymond Green on Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum
item.description:
Green said of the Blazers.

“They're not going to lay down. They have great leadership in Dame [Damian Lillard] and C.J. [McCollum] and they're going to come out and continue to play, and play with the force that they can play with. It's on us to make sure we can play with the right mindset and focus, that we know that it takes to close out a series, especially on the road.”

Draymond Green on Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, May 19, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum
item.description:
Steve Kerr on defending @Damian Lillard & @CJ McCollum In Game 2:

“They’re both fantastic players. We’re under no illusion we’re going to stop them. We’re well aware they’re going to heat up at times. We’ve got to continue to defend & follow our plan & see if we can build on Game 1”

Steve Kerr on Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, May 15, 2019. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.

item.title: Damian Lillard on CJ McCollum
item.description:
Damian Lillard on CJ McCollum's left knee injury and when his backcourt mate might return:

“I don’t want him to have to rush it. And when he does come back, I want him to be himself and be healthy. So, in my mind, we’re going to finish the regular season without him.”

Damian Lillard on CJ McCollum, Mar 19, 2019. Source: Twitter @BlazerFreeman.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on CJ McCollum, Damian Lillard
item.description:
Kerry Eggers:Rick Carlisle on @Damian Lillard:

“He never gets rattled by things that happen early in games. He’s put in the work, so he believes in his game.@CJ McCollum does, too. They’re both terrific. (Defending them) is 48 minutes of making it as tough as possible on those guys.”

Rick Carlisle on CJ McCollum, Damian Lillard, Dec 23, 2018. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum
item.description:
Kerry Eggers:Doc Rivers on @Damian Lillard and @CJ McCollum playing more together this season:

“Lillard’s numbers are better with McCollum on the floor. there’s a reason— there’s more than one guy to worry about.”

Doc Rivers on Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Nov 8, 2018. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.

item.title: Damian Lillard on CJ McCollum
item.description:
Damian Lillard on the narrative that he and CJ McCollum need to be split up:

“I don’t agree with it. I think it’s that simple. I think it’s the easiest thing to say. I don't agree with it.”

Damian Lillard on CJ McCollum, Apr 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @BlazerFreeman.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum
item.description:
More from Rondo on predictions for Blazers-#Pelicans and Game 4:

“It’s not over yet. It’s a big game Saturday, and we have to approach it that way... I’m sure Dame (Lillard) and C.J. (McCollum) aren’t going to go out without swinging and fighting. It’s going to be a scrappy game”

Rajon Rondo on Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Apr 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Evan Turner, Al-Farouq Aminu, Damian Lillard, Moe Harkless, CJ McCollum
item.description:
Brad Stevens on #Blazers:

“You start with how special (Lillard & McCollum) are offensively, but Harkless, Aminu & Turner shooting the ball has really helped. They have a lot of guys you can go to, a lot of efficient players at offensive end & versatile players at defensive end.”

Brad Stevens on Evan Turner, Al-Farouq Aminu, Damian Lillard, Moe Harkless, CJ McCollum, Mar 23, 2018. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum
item.description:
KC Johnson:Wade on Lillard/McCollum:

“This is 1-2 toughest backcourts in the league when you think about Klay and Steph and these two guys.”

Dwyane Wade on Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Nov 15, 2016. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Terry Stotts on CJ McCollum
item.description:
Joe Freeman:Terry Stotts:

“(CJ McCollum) may have scored in double figures in 80 games if I hadn’t screwed up the roster thing. So, sorry about that.”

Terry Stotts on CJ McCollum, Apr 22, 2016. Source: Twitter @BlazerFreeman.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on CJ McCollum
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Dirk on C.J. McCollum's crossover:

“I told him at halftime that was coldblooded, doing the old man like that.”

Dirk Nowitzki on CJ McCollum, Dec 2, 2015. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.
